mapper.sql: SELECT n.id, n.recipient_user_id, n.actor_user_id, actor.name AS actor_name, n.company_id, n.metric_id, n.notification_type, n.title, n.message, n.target_url, n.is_read, n.read_at, n.created_at FROM esg_notifications n LEFT JOIN users actor ON actor.id = n.actor_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY CASE WHEN company_id = #{companyId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id
SELECT m.input_user_id FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.input_user_id WHERE m.id = #{metricId} AND u.role = 'COMPANY_MANAGER' AND u.is_active = TRUE
SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'COMPANY_MANAGER' AND is_active = TRUE AND (company_id = #{companyId} OR #{companyId} IS NULL) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_notifications ( recipient_user_id, actor_user_id, company_id, metric_id, notification_type, title, message, target_url, is_read, created_at ) VALUES ( #{recipientUserId}, #{actorUserId}, #{companyId}, #{metricId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetUrl}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM esg_notifications WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE esg_notifications SET is_read = TRUE, read_at = COALESCE(read_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND is_read = FALSE
